name: CA-26
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's D+9 partisan lean in a favorable Democratic environment
Irwin's large fundraising and outside-spending edge over Gallucci
Open seat with no incumbent on the ballot adds uncertainty
Prediction markets price the Democrat near 95%
model.rationale: The seat's D+9 lean and a Democratic-tilted environment point to a comfortable hold, and Jacqui Irwin has outraised Sam Gallucci roughly two-to-one with substantial outside support while he has little cash. Because this is an open seat with no polling, the forecast sits below the baseline's Safe D rating but still clearly favors the Democrat.
model.watch: A late surge of Republican outside spending or a top-two runoff dynamic pairing Irwin against Gallucci could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Julia Brownley (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Democrats defend an open Ventura County seat after Julia Brownley's retirement, with state assemblymember Jacqui Irwin carrying the party banner against Republican Sam Gallucci. The district leans Democratic by about nine points, and the political environment has favored the party holding the seat. Markets price the Democrat's chances near 95 percent.

Irwin has raised more than $820,000 and benefits from over $360,000 in outside support, while Gallucci has raised under $400,000 with almost no cash on hand and no visible outside backing. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on fundamentals and money, pointing to a Democratic hold in the Likely D range.
